source: Lets make 3d game with floating island kingdoms with waterfalls,brigdes and a giant crystal castle and around the island you can find 5 diffrent temples with 5 diffrent bosses you can fight and earn coins to unlock new weapons and when you first start make the player equip a katana and when the equip it make some mobs spawn for them to fight so they can updgrade from a katana. also make it when you have 1,000 coins you can create your own clans to go out on adventures and experience and fight new enemies. also make the map 1,000,000,000,000 blocks big. and when you get enough xp make it so you can level up and unlock new maps and the max level right now is level 5,000.

answers.ask: A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level?
answers.answer: Use a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up; this keeps the huge-world feeling while making progression playable.

answers.ask: Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want?
answers.answer: Use a bright anime-fantasy look, with colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls.

answers.ask: Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge?
answers.answer: Make each of the five temples its own floating island reached by bridges from the main crystal-castle island.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level? A: Use a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up; this keeps the huge-world feeling while making progression playable.
- [author] theme — Q: Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want? A: Use a bright anime-fantasy look, with colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls.
- [author] shape — Q: Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge? A: Make each of the five temples its own floating island reached by bridges from the main crystal-castle island.
- [agent_inferred] temple encounter placement — Q: Are the five boss encounters inside temple interiors or on the islands outside? A: Place each boss encounter on an open temple forecourt so no unrequested interior map is invented.

## Enriched image prompt
Build the first map of a bright anime-fantasy action RPG as a cluster of six colorful floating islands. One large central island carries a giant glowing crystal castle and the player arrival ground. Arrange five smaller temple islands around it, each with one distinct temple and an open forecourt for its boss encounter. Connect every temple island directly to the central castle island with a dramatic bridge, forming five readable outward routes. Add glowing crystal formations and waterfalls pouring from the island edges into open air. Near the castle, include a compact training encounter area where ordinary mobs can appear when the starting katana is equipped. Include a clearly locked outbound threshold representing the later separate maps that level progression will unlock, without inventing those maps' scenery.

## Genre
The dominant genre is RPG, with Adventure secondary for the outward temple expeditions.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-chaptered` because the full world is explicitly a set of separate level-unlocked maps. The matched preset is Action RPG, with its map structure changed from hub-and-dungeons to chaptered realms while retaining a central hub, encounter ground, and hostile emitters.

## Config requirements
Use `landmark-focal` for the giant crystal castle visible from all six islands. Use the universal `island-cluster` for exactly six floating landmasses: one central castle island and five temple islands. Use `water-body` for dramatic waterfalls flowing from island edges, and `terrain-relief` for the islands' raised cliffs without stacked overlap. Use `hazard-aggro` for one compact mob-training ground near the castle and five open temple boss forecourts. Use `gate-progression` for the visible locked threshold to later level-unlocked maps. Draw the visible half of `spawn-area`, taken from No Genre's catalogue row, as the arrival ground beside the crystal castle.

## Layout requirements
Place one `spawn-area` SpawnZone beside the crystal castle, oriented toward the five bridges. Place six `spawner-npc` Spawners: one in the near-castle training ground for ordinary mobs and one in each of the five temple forecourts for its boss. Weapon upgrades, coins, clans, experience, levels, and equipment rules are mechanics and add no further placement geometry.

## Layout components
The detailed Crystal Island Cluster map has one central castle island, five surrounding temple islands, five direct bridges, one giant crystal castle, five temples, five boss forecourts, one starter mob-training ground, waterfalls, and glowing crystal formations. A second segment, Level-Unlocked Realms, represents additional separate maps whose scenery and count were not defined by the author; retain it as an unspecified map segment rather than inventing content. Compose the first map radially so the castle is the anchor and every temple route is visible.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: all five bridges must connect the correct temple islands to the central island before the bright fantasy dressing is applied.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is large because six islands, five temples, bridges, encounter forecourts, and the castle must remain individually readable. The theme is bright anime fantasy with colorful floating terrain, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls. The pipeline requires `P4` for the separate level-unlocked maps and `CHECK` for traversal across open-air island gaps; the islands remain radially arranged without self-occluding stacked layers.
